## Hello! I'm João Bonifácio

Physicist by training, currently pursuing my BSc and MSc degrees in Statistics at Universidade Federal de Lavras (UFLA).

My main research and professional work focus on:

- **Machine Learning & Statistical Learning**
- **Time Series Analysis & Forecasting**
- **Concept Drift in Time Series Data**
- **Open-Source R Package Development & Shiny Web Applications**
